mapper.select: SELECT n.NOTIFICATION_NO AS notificationNo, n.USER_NO AS userNo, n.ACTOR_USER_NO AS actorUserNo, u.NICKNAME AS actorNickname, u.PROFILE_IMAGE_URL AS actorProfileImageUrl, n.NOTIFICATION_TYPE AS notificationType, n.MESSAGE AS message, n.BOARD_NO AS boardNo, n.COMMENT_NO AS commentNo, n.READ_YN AS readYn, DATE_FORMAT(n.CREATED_AT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS createdAt FROM NOTIFICATION n LEFT JOIN USER u ON n.ACTOR_USER_NO = u.USER_NO WHERE n.USER_NO = #{userNo} ORDER BY n.CREATED_AT DESC, n.NOTIFICATION_NO DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM NOTIFICATION WHERE USER_NO = #{userNo} AND READ_YN = 'N'
mapper.update: UPDATE NOTIFICATION SET READ_YN = 'Y', READ_AT = NOW() WHERE USER_NO = #{userNo} AND READ_YN = 'N'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO NOTIFICATION ( USER_NO, ACTOR_USER_NO, NOTIFICATION_TYPE, MESSAGE, BOARD_NO, COMMENT_NO, READ_YN, CREATED_AT ) SELECT b.USER_NO, #{actorUserNo}, 'LIKE', CONCAT(a.NICKNAME, '님이 회원님의 레시피에 좋아요를 눌렀습니다'), b.BOARD_NO, NULL, 'N', NOW() FROM BOARD b JOIN USER a ON a.USER_NO = #{actorUserNo} WHERE b.BOARD_NO = #{boardNo} AND b.USER_NO != #{actorUserNo}

INSERT INTO NOTIFICATION ( USER_NO, ACTOR_USER_NO, NOTIFICATION_TYPE, MESSAGE, BOARD_NO, COMMENT_NO, READ_YN, CREATED_AT ) SELECT b.USER_NO, #{actorUserNo}, 'SCRAP', CONCAT(a.NICKNAME, '님이 회원님의 레시피를 스크랩했습니다'), b.BOARD_NO, NULL, 'N', NOW() FROM BOARD b JOIN USER a ON a.USER_NO = #{actorUserNo} WHERE b.BOARD_NO = #{boardNo} AND b.USER_NO != #{actorUserNo}

INSERT INTO NOTIFICATION ( USER_NO, ACTOR_USER_NO, NOTIFICATION_TYPE, MESSAGE, BOARD_NO, COMMENT_NO, READ_YN, CREATED_AT ) SELECT b.USER_NO, #{actorUserNo}, 'COMMENT', CONCAT(a.NICKNAME, '님이 ''', b.BOARD_TITLE, '''에 댓글을 달았습니다'), b.BOARD_NO, #{commentNo}, 'N', NOW() FROM BOARD b JOIN USER a ON a.USER_NO = #{actorUserNo} WHERE b.BOARD_NO = #{boardNo} AND b.USER_NO != #{actorUserNo}

INSERT INTO NOTIFICATION ( USER_NO, ACTOR_USER_NO, NOTIFICATION_TYPE, MESSAGE, BOARD_NO, COMMENT_NO, READ_YN, CREATED_AT ) SELECT parent.USER_NO, #{actorUserNo}, 'REPLY', CONCAT(a.NICKNAME, '님이 회원님의 댓글에 답글을 달았습니다'), #{boardNo}, #{commentNo}, 'N', NOW() FROM COMMENT parent JOIN USER a ON a.USER_NO = #{actorUserNo} WHERE parent.COMMENT_NO = #{parentCommentNo} AND parent.USER_NO != #{actorUserNo}

INSERT INTO NOTIFICATION ( USER_NO, ACTOR_USER_NO, NOTIFICATION_TYPE, MESSAGE, BOARD_NO, COMMENT_NO, READ_YN, CREATED_AT ) SELECT target.USER_NO, #{actorUserNo}, 'FOLLOW', CONCAT(a.NICKNAME, '님이 회원님을 팔로우하기 시작했습니다'), NULL, NULL, 'N', NOW() FROM USER target JOIN USER a ON a.USER_NO = #{actorUserNo} WHERE target.USER_EMAIL = #{targetEmail} AND target.USER_NO != #{actorUserNo}

INSERT INTO NOTIFICATION ( USER_NO, ACTOR_USER_NO, NOTIFICATION_TYPE, MESSAGE, BOARD_NO, COMMENT_NO, READ_YN, CREATED_AT ) SELECT f.USER_NO, #{actorUserNo}, 'RECIPE', CONCAT(a.NICKNAME, '님의 새 레시피 ''', b.BOARD_TITLE, '''가 올라왔습니다'), b.BOARD_NO, NULL, 'N', NOW() FROM BOARD b JOIN USER a ON a.USER_NO = #{actorUserNo} JOIN FOLLOWING f ON f.FOLLOWING_ID = a.USER_EMAIL WHERE b.BOARD_NO = #{boardNo} AND b.OPEN = 'Y' AND f.USER_NO != #{actorUserNo} AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM NOTIFICATION n WHERE n.NOTIFICATION_TYPE = 'RECIPE' AND n.BOARD_NO = b.BOARD_NO AND n.USER_NO = f.USER_NO )
